notes.title: Patch Notes 1.5.1
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/79c710cf84385afb6ffd4c5c9ee9307a58f92b50.png"]

Valve recently tested Doomsday for Steam Deck compatibility!



I made a few changes to the default branch in order to make it play a bit easier on Steam Deck. The game was originally tested on the console- but newer updates like the Compendium weren't checked and the text could be small and hard to read.



The text size is now a fair bit bigger for features where it was previously very small. I did some light testing on this- but it's possible there were some unintended results so if you see a bit of formatting junk then shoot me a message.



Steam Deck compatibility will still show "Playable" because we're just under the requested guidelines- but you won't see anything that's an eye strain to read anymore.

 Content Changes
Fixed a typo in the feet loving ghost event.


Misc
Text sizes on the Collections menu, Achievement Tabs, button hints, and the Unlocks menu has been bumped up for easier reading on Steam Deck.

If the game is launched on Steam Deck and no prior save file exists, the resolution will automatically switch to Steam Deck's native resolution. If a save file does exist, the resolution won't change.


Future Projects?
I recently created a Steam Developer Page. You can follow me there to be notified when new games come out, or just to stare at the cover art for Doomsday and let the time drift around you.  

Last month I started recruiting voice actors to join my voice roster for an upcoming project. You can find the posts on BlueSky or X- and if you're interested in submitting but didn't see it, feel free to contact me there or on the game's Discord server to submit an audition.

Once I've got something a little more substantial to share, I'll be polling the community for feedback and playtesting- so if you're interested in that kind of thing then consider joining the game's Discord server. There wont' be any movement for a few months, but I'll start dropping some sneak peaks in a few months when things have progressed a bit farther.

notes.title: Content Wave 3- Patch Notes 1.5
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/79c710cf84385afb6ffd4c5c9ee9307a58f92b50.png
Content Wave 3 - Version 1.5 Patch Notes
Well everyone, we're finally here- the final content update, coming one year after the game's initial launch.

As far as content updates go- this one's a bit smaller. It's more of a victory lap- rounding out the game with a new boss, some new costumes, and some bugfixes.

As far as first indie games go, Doomsday did really well- but it's no secret that it never got big. I'll continue fixing any bugs that pop up- but this will likely be the last content update unless we have a big Cinderella moment.

Thank you all for playing and taking this journey with me! I'm thinking a bit more about the future, and while the Discord is a little slow between updates it's where I'll be pulling testers and players for future games. Consider joining it if you're interested in that sort of thing.

[center]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/1420f44cccef81a9462f925e60f58fc683512256.gif[/center]

New Content
A new boss, Krogath, joins the game! Discover 60 endings to unlock the monster on the key art!
New costumes for Jim, Azla, Plimbo, Sophie, and Ben are now available! Check the Unlocks menu for their requirements!
God Mother has a new costume! Check it out on Holiday mode!


Bugfixes
Online stability improvements when continuing a previous game.
Online stability improvements made when combat begins- especially for later game combats.
Fixed a bug where the Credits page was cutting off a small number of voice actors from the list.
Fixed a bug where ditching the boss counted twice for unlock progression.

notes.title: Wave 2 Update- Version 1.4.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/79c710cf84385afb6ffd4c5c9ee9307a58f92b50.png
It's been a while since the last game update! But I'm here and ready with the Wave 2 update, just in time for the launch of the Nintendo Switch version!

Getting the game to run on the Nintendo Switch required a huge overhaul to the way the game loads and stores information. Alongside the new content, you should expect significantly reduced start up load times and memory usage- meaning you'll be able to play on even weaker machines than before.

I don't want to keep anyone waiting. Here are the patch notes!

Patch Notes 1.4.0
New Content

Unlockable enemy Merrow joins the fray.
Unlockable boss Sun Champ joins the fray.
The Unlocks menu will showcase what costumes and enemies you still need to unlock... and their unlock conditions.
The Collection menu will showcase everything you've found!
A brand new Holiday Mode toggle will let you guarantee bosses appear in their holiday threads!
The Spark Mother quest has now been enabled.


Backend

The startup load time is drastically reduced.
The game's memory consumption is drastically reduced.
The game no longer lags briefly when opening the Library menu.


Bugfixes

Fixed a bug where Godmother would not unlock despite completing her unlock condition.
Typo fixes! But very few here.
Minor UI tweaks to the Ending Cards.
Fixed collection counters.
Cleaned up a couple buggy UI transitions.
Sound / Voice test key prompts are now always visible.
Achievements now properly reset when resetting your save data.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3.4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/79c710cf84385afb6ffd4c5c9ee9307a58f92b50.png
Patch Notes 1.3.4
This is set to be another small patch as we gear up for the wave 2 update. Special thanks to all the completionists in my Discord who have been sending in bug reports and typos! This patch is thanks to them.

You may notice that the last patch notes were for 1.3.2- so what gives? 1.3.3 was pushed out! But it was some backend online stability fixes, and I thought a patch note that just read "more online tweaks" wasn't going to be all that exciting.

Feature Tweaks

Abandons are now counted even if you fail to save the world. Your stats pages will modify slightly as a result of this update.


Bug Fixes

Fixed a game hang that would occur after killing a non-boss enemy with the Blockbreaker item.
Fixed a bug causing Doomsday Paradise 15 to misattribute all affection to Brymelle.
Very many typo fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.3.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
I've received a handful of reports around crashes for 3-4 player games. Thanks to these reports and the accompanying save files- we've got numerous fixes! I've tested these pretty thoroughly, but I'm just one guy so let me know if you hit anything strange.

To the best of my knowledge the online mode should just work now, but as always please submit a bug report if you encounter any issues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/79c710cf84385afb6ffd4c5c9ee9307a58f92b50.png

Online Bugfixes

Fixed a bug that could cause disconnects when entering the character select screen.
Fixed a bug that could cause disconnects when leaving the character select screen.
Fixed a bug that could cause disconnects after selecting a character.
Fixed a bug that could cause disconnects at the start of an in-combat turn in larger games.
Reduced the latency threshold before packet buffering to 50 ms from 100 ms.
Fixed a bug where Fairy Godmother would display the wrong Tooth Fairies to joining players.
The Shuffle Bug event no longer crashes the game.


Other Bugfixes

Diverse Crowd now works as intended.
The Rave effects have been restored to the Doomsday Party

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/79c710cf84385afb6ffd4c5c9ee9307a58f92b50.png
We haven't had much in the way of bug reports since the last update, so this is a very small update. 

The next content update will hit sometime this summer, so I'll be focused mostly on bugfixes until then. If you hit any issues, please leave a bug report in the Steam forums! It's the best way to bring them to my attention.

Fixed Bugs

Fixed a bug where Goblin King wouldn't appear in the introductory "Doom Approaches" screen.
Removed Puff Puff Pillow from the random item pool.
The unlock menu will now show bosses in their holiday threads if they're dressed up
Small Typo Fix

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3 - Online Fixes and More
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/79c710cf84385afb6ffd4c5c9ee9307a58f92b50.png
I hope everyone's been enjoying the Wave 1 Update! Now that the dust has settled a bit, I've got a new patch with some new fixes and a little surprise.

Online Fixes
This patch should fix most, if not all, the outstanding problems with the game's online mode. Please give it a try and let me know if you hit any more problems! This is thanks to everyone who was able to send me in-progress save files- which were incredibly helpful in reproducing these issues.


Fixed a bug where quitting the game with the force quit button with the inventory open would crash the game.
Fixed a bug where the host player would not convert the game to a local one when all other players had left.
Fixed a bug where online games would disconnect when a player entered combat with a large inventory.
Fixed a bug where online games would disconnect when a player started their turn.
Fixed a bug where online games would disconnect when loading a continue file at specific latency sweet spots.


Text Fixes

Fixed a bug where the Cursed Buckler had a period at the end of its name.
Misc typo fixes.


Polish

Improved the transition when opening the Online menu.
Added a message when the online game lookup fails. This can be fixed by exiting and re-entering the Online menu.
The Gallery Menu plays more nicely with mouse controls.
The Credits Menu plays more nicely with the mouse wheel.


Other

A certain boss monster is wearing green! See if you can track them down.
The "End" button in combat won't appear until all your cards for the turn are drawn.

notes.title: Content Wave 1 - Patch Notes 1.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/79c710cf84385afb6ffd4c5c9ee9307a58f92b50.png
Patch Notes - Version 1.2
New Content
This represents the first of two planned content drops for Doomsday Paradise. One of the goals was to increase variety around the Hospital location specifically- since very few quest lines started there. There's lots more to explore!

Challenge requirements haven't changed, so it should now be much easier to reach some of the end level completion achievements.

2 new unlockable enemies have been added to the game!
1 new unlockable boss has been added to the game!
2 new friends have been added to the game!
3 new skills have been added to the game!
2 new items have been added to the game!
25 new scenarios have been added to the game!
10 new endings have been added to the game!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/84352d9c6e77cd46f3e3724b2785baeb639dfab0.gif
Bugfixes
I discovered some software that allows me to mimic higher latency connections- and used it as an opportunity to fix some bugs with the online mode on slower network speeds. Please continue sending me any online issues you might have!

Fixed a bug where the game would indefinitely hang during online sessions after a joining player made a choice on slower connections.
Fixed a bug where enemy attacks had a chance of crashing the game on slower connections.
Fixed a bug where item activations might crash the game on slower connections.
Fixed a bug where a host player entering sleep mode would break their game.
Fixed a bug where the online keyboard would pop up for the 2nd / 3rd player in an online game when choosing a name despite not hovering over the Custom name selection.


Gameplay

Meteor now a free 2x Mag skill to be on par with other rare magic skills.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/79c710cf84385afb6ffd4c5c9ee9307a58f92b50.png
Patch Notes
New Content

A new boss has been added to the game! The boss will be unlocked based on the number of games you've played. Finishing a game (or quitting a game) will unlock the boss if you meet their unlock conditions.
Significantly more in-combat logging for better bug and crash detection.
A new SFX has been added when viewing the endings screen.


Bugfixes

The online stability fix released last patch now correctly applies to miniboss battles (whoops)
Online stability improvements.
Ending 61 displays the correct text.


Known Issues
The functionality to preview something with hovertext has exposed some skills and items that weren't meant to be visible. These will be translated and corrected in the next content update, when everything goes through localization!

Some item/skill tooltips don't have translations.
Some item/skill tooltips are improperly named, or have typos.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/f64a6131919528c9a64b68a84375d17b4bc4dded.png
Online Stability
With the Steam sale I saw a lot more reviews mentioning the online experience.

Online tends to either work perfectly -or be a bit of a mess. Unfortunately, I'm in the camp where it works perfectly- so I've had an extremely hard time locating the exact issues. The stability improvements I've shipped have all helped- but I'm still flying a little blind.

If on this patch you encounter online issues, join the Discord server and I'll be happy to join you for a game with the dev!

This way, if we find the issue and can replicate it- I can figure out exactly what's breaking with my debug build and we can solve the issue on the spot. This is also why this patch has more in-depth logging- in order to better track down when things are falling apart.

If you WERE hitting online issues but AREN'T anymore on this patch- also let me know!

Because the online works for me, I also can't be confident the patches I ship out solve things for everyone. Stop by the community forums or Discord server and let me know!

The game is developed by just a single person, so all feedback is super helpful.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/f658937e9a0aa834b9f7911f9916d8ff7110b9ae.png
When things Break
If your game disconnects, hold the E/Start button to return to the title screen. From there, the game's host can try to Continue it by navigating to "Online" and then pressing "Continue". This will create a new lobby that will pick up where the old game left off.

If this isn't working and you're crashing in the same spot, get in touch!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/de1f84d0299d10d0bcb2722d8fb2e3ed0eb67d8c.gif
Upcoming
Wave 1 will release sometime next month, and will include new enemies, bosses, endings, and scenarios!

Until then, I'll be heads down on that and working on some bugfixes.

Thanks everyone for playing!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.5 + Roadmap
notes.notes:
The next round of bugfixes is in! Let's go over the updates as well as the upcoming roadmap.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/79c710cf84385afb6ffd4c5c9ee9307a58f92b50.png
Patch  Notes
New

Ending 5 has alternate text based on the choice you made during the Doomsday Party.
New Icons for a small handful of skills that were sharing art with others.
This patch has a special surprise! See if you can find it.


Polish

Name Select has the Custom name at the top of the screen instead of the bottom to be easier to use for Steam Deck and controller setups.
There's now a proper tooltip when hovering over your Dodge %
Art Gallery now wraps long names.
Buff skills now "count up" when activated.


Bugfixes

Online stability updates should reduce the number of disconnects in combat.
Ghost tooltips should now actually be gone from status icons.
Purifying an item no longer causes the reroll indicator to appear over it.
Canceling a hosted "continue" game should no longer bug out the next attempt to host it.
Echo Blade will no longer crash your game after you equip a duplicate of an existing weapon.
Cleo's Stat Detection uses correct HP value.
Powder Monkey and Pacifist use the correct icons.
Items correctly "count up" when activated in combat.
Misc. text updates and typo fixes.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/3c39d962c183d0f0ec13ddb11cff469fb5a378c9.png
Upcoming Roadmap
Let's talk about what content updates will look like for Doomsday! This is what I can talk about publicly for the next few months:

Demons Attack!
First, expect new enemies and bosses over the next few months. These will be dropped in waves, so you have a lot of new toys to play with at once. These enemies and bosses will be free for all players.

New Scenarios and Endings
Secondly, expect a small number of new scenarios and endings. This won't be a huge content update- but my focus will be on making areas with a small number of opening stories have better payoff, and supplying payoff for some followups that don't turn into full endings.

These will also be dropped alongside the enemy updates and will of course also be free and available for all players.

Leave it to me, Captain!
Alongside the new scenarios and endings, expect a few more rewards for the pool. There won't be a ton of these, and they'll be primarily focused on shoring up some gaps in existing builds and playstyles.

Update Format
Adding one enemy or one event at a time isn't a great reason to come back and explore, so content updates will be grouped together in larger waves.

Occasionally, when there's set to be a lull, we can expect some content to be trickled out during slow periods. But for the most part, content will be bunched together in waves, so you can check back in every couple months and find more to do!

The first wave won't come until February, but do expect a few goodies after the holidays are over. Until then, patching will be primarily focused on shoring up bugs. If you find any- feel free to give me a shout!

Until next time,
Shadi @ Lemonade Flashbang

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/79c710cf84385afb6ffd4c5c9ee9307a58f92b50.png
Patch Notes
New

Steam Community Items have now been enabled! You can expect to see trading cards, backgrounds, badges, and more!
Cloud Saving has been enabled.
Mystery Boxes can now grant players weapons.
Mystery Boxes can no longer become mystery boxes.
Mystery Boxes can no longer grant enemies skill-granting items.

Bugfixes

Spirit Bow's tooltip displays the correct damage.
Fixed a bug where you could not complete quests after the Doomsday Party, including quests that could only be completed after the Doomsday Party.
The Good Roommate Quest now gives the correct rewards.
Tooltips no longer appear for status effects and conditions that are not active.
All location text for the Hospital clarifies that you fully heal.
Magical attacks no longer display reduced damage when you're afflicted by weak.
Fixed a bug where Mystery Boxes would sometimes not show their opening animation in online games.
Fixed a bug where items out of a Mystery Box could open behind the player sprite.
Mystery Box Items will no longer appear flipped for enemies.
Typo fixes.

Having Online Troubles?
I've received very few reports of online issues after 1.0.3. If you encounter any issue going forward, please do the following!

1. Send me the file at C:\Users\{YOUR_USER}\AppData\Roaming\LemonadeFlashbang\DoomsdayParadise\midgame_save.dat
2. Alongside the file, let me know what happened. ("Me and a friend were playing and right after my items activated he disconnected and the game broke.")

With your midgame save, I should be able to test that particular part multiple times to look for vulnerabilities and can hopefully find a quick resolution.

Upcoming
I'll be going on holiday vacation soon! For the next two weeks, there won't be any additional patches. Fortunately, the game appears pretty stable but if you encounter any issues leave a note in the bug thread.

However, there's some stuff cooking right now. When I return, expect a new update! Aside from bugfixes, there should be a small amount of new content.

This is also when I'll begin working on update and support for the game going forward. Is there something you want to see? Leave me a message and I'll sift through everything in the week or so after I'm back!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Hotfix 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Patch Notes V 1.0.3
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/79c710cf84385afb6ffd4c5c9ee9307a58f92b50.png
Thanks to the rollout of the save/load function from the last patch, we were able to fix a critical networking error. As a result, I'm pushing out my third patch in one week (I guess these would count as hotfixes).

New
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/f658937e9a0aa834b9f7911f9916d8ff7110b9ae.png
When continuing an online game, you can now pick which character you'd like to play as.

Bugfixes

Typo fixes
Fixed a bug that would occasionally cause network disruption at a critical moment at the start of combat, causing multiplayer games to hang endlessly.
Fixed a bug where full screen mode would have offset mouse positioning.
Fixed a bug where the stats cards would have incorrect coloring when continuing a game.
Fixed a bug where a minion could softlock the game by attempting to cast a buff spell after you'd been killed by thorns.
Fixed a bug where a player who partied in an online game then joined a second one and then fought could see desync'd endings (and the reverse).
Fixed a bug where you could not reroll an item after purifying it (but for real this time).

notes.title: Patch Notes V 1.0.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/79c710cf84385afb6ffd4c5c9ee9307a58f92b50.png
Patch Notes V 1.0.2
I've seen more than my fair share of multiplayer disconnects while watching streams over the last week.

Online is hard, and while that's true it's not an excuse for what I feel is an unacceptable play experience. So I've been crunching for the last few days to get this update out the door as soon as possible.

This updates features some bugfixes, typo fixes, and the introduction of mid-game saving. It's been pushed out much faster than a typical cadence because every unfinished game breaks my heart.

New Features
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/7df5717dcd9849b99b0430690363eef284dc0732.png
Mid-game saving
Multiplayer games can take a long time, and it sucks to lose your file and all your progress.

The game will now automatically save after every turn. If something happens, simply press the "Continue" button to resume the game right from the title screen, with all your prior settings intact!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/3053f6dea51212213e5ca7b283cba538eacba69e.png
You can also host your game online for others to join. The second person to join the lobby will take control of player 2, the third player 3, etc., I'd like to get it to where your join order doesn't line up with your character but I didn't want to delay the patch behind additional UI work.

Polish

Item descriptions in the shop now have a shadow so they're slightly easier to read.
Enemy tooltips have the correct styling.
Weapons and Skills now show their names when hovered over instead of nothing.
Some UI elements in the name and costume selection screens have been updated.


Bugfixes

Typo fixes
Fixed a bug where purified curses could not be rerolled unless you re-opened the menu.
Lifewand now displays the correct amount of healing.
Fixed an instance where a line of dialogue was cut shorter than intended.
The previous patch's "reroll lockout" bug has been fixed for skills as well.
The online timeout period should be increased, resulting in far fewer disconnects.

notes.title: Patch Notes V 1.0.1 and Future Roadmap
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/79c710cf84385afb6ffd4c5c9ee9307a58f92b50.png
First- THANK YOU!
We've had a really incredible launch. I'm writing this about a day before this patch will go live- and at the time of writing we have a 99% positive review rate after spending over a day on New and Trending!

I'm a first time commercial dev, so the response being so positive has been completely overwhelming. Thank you all for your support and understanding even when things don't behave perfectly. I'm committed to ensuring that Doomsday continues to get better with time.

Patch Notes Version 1.0.1

Launch has been extremely smooth and relatively bug free- but not quite perfect! There's a few obvious pain points in some small areas that this patch is meant to address.

New Features
 You can now bring up tooltips for your active card by pressing the "Show Stats" button (Alt on PC, bumpers on controllers).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/ee558fed63a05155429f2813cd8407542e4e7bf6.png

 You can now bring up tooltips for your active items by hovering over them with the mouse. Note that this doesn't work on skills or equipped weapons, which have damage calculation baked in.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/fc511387900bf783c658c6fa07ea792e6bc486d8.png

Feature Changes
 The mouse will no longer be hidden when a controller is plugged in.
 If you continue pressing left or right in the crush screen, you'll continue scrolling through your potential dates.

Bugfixes
 Trying to reroll without any reroll tokens will no longer cause the back / close menu button to lock out.
 Typo fixes.
 Pressing the back / cancel button closes the purify menu and not the underlying item menu when the purify window is active.
 Fixed an issue where, in online multiplayer games with 3-4 players, the joining players could disconnect from one another during a dialogue sequence and cause the game to indefinitely hang.

Roadmap
We're only a few days past release, so I can't give a complete overview of what to expect- a lot of it hasn't been scoped out yet. I do want to touch on where my head currently is at, but that doesn't mean any of this is set in stone. Treat the below as tentative plans and not as promises or guarantees.

Online Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/f64a6131919528c9a64b68a84375d17b4bc4dded.png
I'm a solo developer, which means I can't easily test online connectivity in a lot of circumstances (cross country connections, differences in connection quality, etc.,) And we're seeing the consequences of that a little bit. For some players, online is smooth and there are no issues. For others, the game crashes at the very end and they lose an hour or more of progress.

My absolute first priority is ensuring that fewer games fall apart after a disconnect.

If you've had bugged or crashed games during online, please reach out via Discord or the Steam community forums with a description of what happened. Please be as specific as possible. "It broke" isn't helpful, but "Someone picked a choice and then the game just hanged for everyone, here's the log file" is!

There isn't really one bug with online, but many tiny bugs, so please be patient and report issues as you encounter them! They're very difficult for me to reproduce on my own, but every single bug report helps.

Saving Mid Game
Saving mid game wasn't added because game sessions are pretty short. But when an online game crashes, it's nice to have a backup- and sometimes you don't want to dedicate a whole 2 hours to a 4 player game.

I'll be investigating mid game saves so that, when the worst happens, you can resume where you left off. 

Save systems tend to be pretty complex and it's easy to miss things- so I do request everyone be patient while I figure out how best to implement this. This goes hand in hand with the online improvements as top priority, since having a backup makes the damage done by a disconnect much less severe. 

This will require a bit of UI work, and since we're close to the holidays this might take some time to get playable and polished.

New Content
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/de1f84d0299d10d0bcb2722d8fb2e3ed0eb67d8c.gif
Did you know there are 3 bosses in Doomsday Paradise?

Most content will drop in waves but the very first content update will be a standalone boss, just to inject some variety into your games  (since the 3rd boss is super hard to unlock).

I'll be scoping out the size of future updates after we're through our launch week and I know how much we can realistically afford to spend. All currently planned updates will be relatively small content wise, but completely free.

Cosmetic or Major Content Updates
Future content updates are planned to be small because they're funded through the game's prior Kickstarter. That puts things like new player characters, new romance options, new costumes, big scenario packs, and so on out of reach.

If you're really interested in seeing more of those things- let me know! If enough people are interested, we can definitely try some DLC, but I want to ensure we focus on things players actually want. Try to be specific if you can!

And, of course, if you'd rather I start on another game or a sequel instead- that's also fair and valid. Just leave your feedback where I can find it! I'll be reading through them in the coming week.

notes.title: Beta Update - V 0.6
notes.notes:
This is a massive patch which includes most of the planned launch features! The game still isn't quite done yet, but this patch gets us most of the way there.

If you have beta access- give it a try and let me know about any bugs you reach along the way!

At 190k words of pure dialogue, if you printed out every scenario it would be as long as Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire- a 750 page hardcover book!

Feature and Gameplay Changes

There are now 400 unique scenarios!
There are now 120 different endings!
Two new enemies- Tooth Fairy and Hive Queen- join the fray!
Sophie receives her first skin!
Challenges have been implemented- and have Achievement integration!
Gallery Mode has been implemented!
The Shop has new art!
New background images for several screens!
113 / 120 endings now have custom art!


Bugfixes and Polish Tweaks

Turn Counter no longer breaks out of alignment when killing bosses.
Turn Counter positioning tweaks.
Ending List scrollbar fixed
Vando Monastary events now occur in the correct order
Dragonslayer equips weapons in the correct order
Enemies now properly equip weapons
Reworked HUD animations for items/skills to be a little cleaner
Plimbo no longer jumps into Hell at the start of combat
Fixed a bug where demons could take over the Hospital
Minor text fixes
Buff SFX tweaked to be less grating


Roadmap
Here's a list of the things I CAN discuss:

The rest of the monsters and skins still need to be added
Placeholder assets need to be removed!


But it's not everything. Next month I'll make an announcement about future development and hopefully even release timing!

Thanks,
Shadi

notes.title: Beta Patch V 0.5
notes.notes:
A new patch with a lot of momentum as we near release! Expect one or two more massive content patches in the coming months.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/4d75bffa64ded6fafe8a647a6865662cbf30848d.png
Large Changes

New Events: The game now has 302 events- up by almost 70 since V 0.4!
New Endings: The game now features 102 endings- up by almost 50 since V 0.4!
A New Character: You can now play as Plimbo, the Tyrant!

notes.title: Beta Patch V0.4
notes.notes:
Now that Friendship Games Festival and Steam Next Fest are over- we can resume with larger changes that are more likely to break things!

This is a pretty large upgrade over last week's build, so the version number is ticking up to 0.4!

Feel free to goof around and see if any of the new stuff breaks!

Content

 Five New Soundtracks are now implemented!
This isn't the only upcoming music update, but it's a big one! I'm working on making sure that different phases of the game don't blend together, so expect more track changes in the future.

 27 New Items and Skills!
That's right- there's a ton of new content to be found. Most of these will be restricted to random card rewards since they're not acquirable in any existing events... for now.

 Mystery Box Redesign
Shops no longer have a "random item" option. Instead, you can pick up Mystery Boxes! Mystery Boxes transform into random items in combat. The Hoarder ending has had its requirements change to center on mystery boxes now, to make it less likely to be acquired on accident.

 Birthday Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/9eb44ec21751c361ae158a9bcbb926cb7a124bb9.gif
In Birthday Mode, every single character- including enemies- gets a mystery box during combat!

 The Frank x Gretchen Paired Ending Rewritten
I'm not sure if anyone's managed to get this ending yet- because it was deviously hard. It's been rewritten and the requirements updated to comply with existing game logic.

 Medic and Frank's minion sprites now comply with the Geneva Convention.
Frank's full art is still being worked on, but will follow soon.


Game Feel

 The countdown animation on skills has been redesigned.
 The boss now takes poison/burn damage just before dying in its overkill state.
 The "Choose your Name" screen has updated buttons for confirm/random. 
 Tutorials will no longer show the complete button until you scroll through every panel.
This is one of those changes that's kind of annoying for seasoned players, but prevents lots of folks from accidentally closing too early and spending the whole game confused.
 First tutorial slightly modified to showcase advanced tutorials
 There is now a Multi-Wield icon next to the weapons indicator on the stats card.
 Vote Time transition shifted up to 2.5 seconds from 1, and new elements for Group Votes introduced.
 Overkill Counter will now appear even when you perfect kill an enemy.
 There are now particles that play over avatars during invincible / overkill phases.
 The "You Died" screen won't pop up if you die during a miniboss encounter.


Balance

 Medic now starts with healing wave instead of regen.
 Casino Chips now grants 6 poison per turn instead of 2.
 Dark Knight now casts Buffaga instead of Anger.
 Dark Knight has 20 additional max hp.
 Captain Al's romance quest requires 4 party members instead of 5.
 Enemy dodging logic changed.
 Sudden Death now kills enemies first.
 You can no longer reach negative health while invincible in combat, which would kill you when combat ended.


Bugfixes

 Fixed a bug where several items did not activate during combat.
 The Maskman Shop Event will now correctly occur.
 Inflicting Frail no longer causes healing/status tooltips to adjust their displayed values.
 Fixed a bug where you could not select the Tutorials button in the Settings menu with a controller.
 Frank is now using the correct minion art.
 The pre-fight moon transition should now clear out items before playing.
 Branding Strike is no longer free.
 Selecting Haley as your crush no longer gives you extra Friendship.

notes.title: Demo Update - Patch 0.3.7
notes.notes:
The last week has been pretty hectic! I've probably watched 20-30 hours of streamed gameplay during that time, and while many of these things were rolled out incrementally they're now being bundled together in a single larger patch coinciding with when I updated the demo!

Changes are as follows:

Gameplay Changes

Weapon attacks are no longer free
Weapons were originally free because you need Multi-Wield to use them, so they they were effectively 1 Skill + 1 Item in terms of power so I didn't feel like they needed to cost a Brain to use as well. This was largely a mistake- because getting even 2-3 weapons was enough to ramp damage considerably. Weapons will still be very good, but now you might need some brainpower as well.

Breaker Blade now grants +1 STR on Equip, instead of +2.
Breaker Blade start was so much stronger than the others it was warping the early game. This tones it down.

Penetrator reduces enemy defense by 1 instead of by 2.
Penetrator just adding 2 damage to everything got really insane- especially in a multiplayer game where you might hit more than one.

Shop Odds Adjusted
The shop used to offer 1 common, 1 uncommon, and 1 rare item. This made it really easy to find a bunch of extremely strong gear (like diamond armor). The shop now rolls three times and offers:

1x Common Item
1x (50%) Common OR (50%) Uncommon Item
1x (25%) Common OR (50%) Uncommon OR (25%) Rare Item

This change means the Shop, in general, offers weaker gear.

Romance Requirements no longer scale with game difficulty
Most players were just going to a single location every single turn to meet romance requirements, and I think that's a lame gameplay pattern so I've made getting a date generally easier.

Enemy HP Increased
Enemies were getting one rounded very quickly. This change mostly affects Adventure and War mode- Vacation mode is mostly untouched.

Skulldweller Tweaks
Skulldweller having Thorns on Adventure Mode ended up being super punishing. I've taken the ability away, but kept it on his War Mode incarnation where having a stronger strategy is probably warranted.

Tutorials in the Pause Menu
You can now access all the tutorials in the game via the Controls Menu! A few players accidentally closed it, so this should help in case they need to revisit them.

New Transition in the Endgame
There's a new transition when the Doomsday Party is over! This'll be accompanied with a music change in the future.


Art / Animation Updates

Skulldweller Skill Animation Update
New Art for endings 3, 4, 37, 38, 42, and 61.


Bugfixes

So, so many typos...
Voiceline that plays when a Miniboss reveals has changed
You can no longer "tab out" of the controls menu when you have a sub-menu open
The Shuffle Bug group vote event now applies on Friendship as well
Fixed a bug where you could Close the "Endings" popup with the escape key, and it would stall the game at the score screen
Fixed a bug where buffing enemy demons would alter romance requirements
Fixed a visual bug where items in your inventory would be loaded over your fighter in the wrong order
You will no longer enter Sudden Death when an enemy is in its overkill state
Tweaked the EventRunner so there should no longer be single frame hiccups when the dialogue screen appears
Enemies will now start with the agility they were meant to have
You should no longer get heart particles for completing romance quests that are disabled
You should no longer get a quest notification about completed quests that are disabled
Fixed a bug where a Gleo quest would appear if you had turned the questline down
You will only receive a stat-based ending if it's your highest stat
Fixed a bug where buffing monsters would give them higher difficulty skill loadouts

notes.title: Beta Patch V0.3 - The Big One
notes.notes:
Patch Notes V 0.3
Hello! It's been a month without patches- but that's because the ones in the works were huge!

This is a beta patch- so there's a couple in-process things to note, which I'll do so below. Let's start off with a summary graphic of the changes, and then I'll go into upcoming features and so on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41677891/0d8e3a7941fcee4ee761c029e4fd5636cbedc431.png

Major Features

Azla-Kathy joins the crew as the fifth playable character! I hope you come to love her as much as I do!
Azla, Jim, Ben, Sophie, Stabby Jack, Hero, and Dark Knight (formerly Galaxy Knight) are all on the new visual system.
Skulldweller and Plimbo are using placeholder art (Hero and Azla respectively) for combat for the time being.
~40 new scenarios and ~10 new endings.
Revamped Tutorial System!
A stats menu, tutorials menu, and ending tracker are now accessible from the title screen!
Micah and Umbra join the cast- rounding out our romance options!
Complete redesign of the difficulty modes. Enemies will get more items, skills, and stats at higher difficulties- and yours will be lower!
Poison now loses half its potency after each turn instead of just one.


Minor Features

The game's been tested on Steam Deck! There's been some tweaks to the UI to make it a better playing experience, and the on-screen keyboard now properly appears when selecting a custom name.
New ending art for a handful of endings! We're chugging away on getting every single one custom art.
The feedback form pop ups no longer appear after a game.
Story Mode and God Mode have been removed.
Dark Knight has updated voice lines!
Lots and lots and lots and lots of polish tweaks.


In Progress

Skulldweller should receive updated art within the next week.
Micah, Umbra, Runt, Bubso, and many minions with missing art should receive their art soon.
Plimbo will be receiving his own art soon as well.
Stabby Jack and Dark Knight will receive a couple more animations to better signal their Overkill state.
There are ~20 events currently being tested for implementation and those should roll out next week.
Updated art for even more endings!
More music! We're working on doubling the amount of music in game right now.


What to watch for
The Steam Next Fest demo will be coming up next week, and will be using mostly this patch- so there'll be a lot more frequent patching this week as new assets come in at the last minute and bugs get squashed.

Expect maybe a few more bugs than normal since there are so many features in the patch, and expect some enemy numbers to get tweaked as balance gets ironed out.

If you play the game and have any feedback- let me know! I'll have my eyes on the lookout.
